contract_source.expected_solution: FastAPI 0.109.0 processes incoming request bodies in fastapi/routing.py and fastapi/dependencies/utils.py. get_request_handler (routing.py) drives each request: it reads and parses the body, then solve_dependencies (dependencies/utils.py) resolves the endpoint signature and request_body_to_args validates the parsed JSON against the endpoint's Pydantic model fields. Validation failures raise RequestValidationError, which is what surfaces as the 422 response. Response-side serialization runs through serialize_response in routing.py with its exclude_unset handling.
evaluation_criteria: Cites fastapi/routing.py and fastapi/dependencies/utils.py as the request validation chain
Names request_body_to_args and solve_dependencies as the body-validation entry points
Identifies RequestValidationError as the source of the 422 responses

consumer_usage.expected_solution: httpx 0.26.0 constructs outgoing request bodies in httpx/_content.py and httpx/_models.py. encode_request (_content.py) dispatches on the content=/data=/files=/json= arguments; encode_json serializes the payload with the stdlib json.dumps (imported as json_dumps) and sets the application/json Content-Type header. Request.__init__ in _models.py calls encode_request to build the headers and body stream.
evaluation_criteria: Cites httpx/_content.py and httpx/_models.py as the request encoding chain
Names encode_request as the dispatch point for body construction
Names encode_json as the JSON serialization path

drift_analysis.expected_solution: The contract drift sits between httpx's encode_json — a bare json_dumps of whatever dict or model dump the caller passes, which preserves explicit null values and emits every key — and FastAPI's request_body_to_args, where Pydantic v2 field validation distinguishes an explicitly-null key from an absent one. A client that serializes unset optional fields as null (instead of omitting them, as exclude_unset-style dumping would) trips validation on non-nullable fields with defaults and yields the 422 RequestValidationError; nested models and unions hit the same seam because json_dumps flattens them without Pydantic's field-level coercion.
evaluation_criteria: Anchors the httpx side of the drift in encode_json / json_dumps serialization
Anchors the FastAPI side of the drift in request_body_to_args Pydantic v2 validation
Explains the None-vs-missing-key mismatch, referencing exclude_unset semantics for unset fields
